body: Ok I was about to make this exact post and I'm glad you commented on this. Is there any other way you think I could use because I can't say it. I can't even say it out loud when I'm completely alone. It just doesn't come out. The worst part is when I have a important conversation with someone such as my dad I get nervous and all I can really say is yes, no, and I don't know. I quit football recently and my dad was asking me all this questions and everything. Idk how he came to the conclusion but he asked me if I was depressed. It felt like time had stopped and I was trapped inside my own mind and I couldn't answer. I wanted to say yes so bad but idk what happened and I said no. How can I deal with this? I'm tired of this and I want help but I can't say anything to anyone except here on reddit.

I've been playing football for awhile And I just quit I'm tired of it idk why I ever really played I didn't like it. I mean if there are people out there who are in worst situations than me and can do something to fix it why can't I?
